text:
Ava Chen: Quick sync — rolling out a small experiment on the pricing page this week. Goals: clarify tier names, shrink FAQ friction, and try a pared-down cost estimator. Draft plan below.

Jordan Patel: sounds good. are we testing copy + calculator together or separate? want to know how to route webinar signups vs sales leads.

Ava Chen: separate variants — A: new tier names + compact FAQ, B: old names + new estimator. We'll also run C as combo. Analytics will attribute conversions to variant. Webinar CTA will appear only on pages in variants B+C to measure inbound quality.

Priya Rao: For lead routing, please tag leads with `pricing_variant` + `tier_clicked`. Sales ops can route high-intent ("Contact sales" clicks) to AE queue; webinar signups to SDR nurture. I can add the segment to the CRM mapping.

Leo Kim: design mocks uploaded: https://redwood.design/figma/pricing-mini-test — compact FAQ uses accordion with microheadings and an inline "Why choose Dedicated?" tooltip. Small copy change suggestion below:

```
Foundational -> Starter
Growth -> Pro
Scale -> Enterprise
```

Jordan Patel: I like Starter/Pro/Enterprise better for clarity. Any legal concerns with renaming tiers?

Priya Rao: No legal blockers. We'll keep internal SKU names unchanged; this is purely UX layer.

marketing-bot: checklist reminder: 1) Variant keys created in Optimizely, 2) GTM event `pricing_variant_view` wired, 3) calculator GA events `estimate_run` + `estimate_commit_toggle`, 4) CRM mapping present.

Ava Chen: permissions: @Jordan, @Priya — can you confirm GTM+CRM mapping by EOD? @Leo — please add microcopy variants (short/shorter) — want both for test.

Jordan Patel: will confirm GTM. I'll add funnel tags for webinar CTA and sales-contact.

Priya Rao: CRM mapping done — mapping doc: https://redwood.docs/pricing-experiments/crm-map.md. Routing: webinar -> marketing_nurture, contact-sales -> AE_inbox.

Leo Kim: uploaded two microcopy options in the figma file. short = 15–20 chars, shorter = 8–12 chars.

Ava Chen: nice. final items: QA checklist for release (copy, links, events, accessibility), and a small eval plan: 7-day test, primary metric = contact-sales rate, secondary = webinar signups and estimator usage rate. We'll also do a quick postmortem + example screenshots for the launch blog.

Jordan Patel: noted. can we also capture avg token cost on pages where the estimator is used? curious about compute-backed estimator hit rate. (not huge, just FYI)

Priya Rao: added `estimator_api_hit` event to the GTM list.

Ava Chen: thanks team. I'll schedule a 15m standup tomorrow at 10:15 to confirm go/no-go. :sparkles: 

Leo Kim: :thumbsup:
